# Smoke-test fixture: "Why is the sky blue?" (≈25 s)

Test data for `yt smoke`, which runs the whole pipeline offline with stub voice, music and SFX.
The quotes in `claims.json` are **illustrative test data**, not verified quotations. Never publish this episode.
The three scenes in `05-scenes/` double as **reference implementations**: the animator agent is pointed at
them as worked examples of kit usage and cue-locked motion (drawn in the kit's default look; real scenes
take their look from their style frames).
